Join a team where you will shape and support modern Digital Workplace services across the full Microsoft ecosystem, from Microsoft 365 and Intune to Identity, Security, and emerging AI capabilities. As a technical expert, you will have the opportunity to solve complex customer challenges, influence service innovation, and help organizations get the most from their Microsoft investments.

**This is what makes the position as Digital Workplace Services Engineer unique

**

• Shape the future of Digital Workplace services by driving innovation, automation, security, and AI-powered solutions across the full Microsoft Modern Workplace ecosystem.

• Act as a technical authority and trusted advisor, solving complex challenges and helping customers maximize the value of their Microsoft investments.

• Work in a collaborative, international team where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and technical excellence are at the heart of everything we do.

The Microsoft Cloud Services team brings together deep technical expertise across Microsoft technologies while fostering a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. Team members work closely across multiple countries, supporting each other on complex customer challenges and continuously learning from one another. Led by Heidi Storm, the team values transparency, accountability, continuous development, and delivering meaningful outcomes for customers.

My name is Heidi Storm. I am the Head of Microsoft Cloud Services. As a leader, I believe in creating an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and empowered to do their best work. I value transparency, collaboration, and continuous learning, and I enjoy helping individuals grow their expertise while working together to solve complex challenges and deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers.

**Your role & influence as Digital Workplace Services Engineer

**Responsibility: You will be given responsibility for designing, operating, and continuously improving Microsoft Digital Workplace services across Microsoft 365, Security, Identity, and Endpoint Management, ensuring high service quality, operational excellence, and customer success.

Collaboration: Together with your team, you take care of designing, operating, and continuously improving Microsoft 365, Security, Identity, and Endpoint Management services. You'll work closely not only with your immediate team members but also with the Service Desk and Customer Success teams to deliver reliable, secure, and value-driven solutions for customers.

_Core activities:

_

• Deliver and support Microsoft Cloud services, managing incidents, service requests, troubleshooting, and escalations across Microsoft 365, Identity, Security, and Endpoint Management environments.

• Drive service quality and continuous improvement by optimizing configurations, maintaining documentation, sharing knowledge, and identifying opportunities for automation and standardization.

• Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, collaborating with internal teams and customers to implement secure, scalable, and value-driven Digital Workplace solutions.

**Benefits Of Joining Dustin

**We believe there's more to Dustin than just the benefits listed here. You'll fully understand this once you're with us. Curious? Our Life at Dustin page has you covered.

**You can find more of our benefits below in the vacancy.

****This Is What We Imagine You Bring

**We envision you as a curious and driven individual who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for solving complex customer challenges, improving services, and staying at the forefront of Microsoft cloud technologies.

Additionally, it's important that:

• You have a bachelor's degree level of working and thinking.

• You have experience designing, administering, and supporting Microsoft 365, Security, Identity, and Endpoint Management services in a customer-focused environment.

• You possess strong technical skills within Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Conditional Access, PIM, Microsoft Defender, and Identity Governance. Nice to have experience includes PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and automation initiatives.

• Danish and English fluency.

**What can you expect next?

**To ensure a fair recruitment process free from unconscious bias, we handle your application anonymously and do not accept cover letters. Please refrain from sending one, so that the selection is based solely on professional competencies. We expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

• Telephone screening.

• 1st interview with Heidi Storm, hiring manager, and/or colleague.

• Assessment (Personality- and cognitive thinking test).

• 2nd interview

• Background check.

For questions about the position, please contact the Heidi Storm, hiring manager, via e-mail: heidi.storm@dustin.com

Copenhagen, Denmark Join Saxo’s First Line of Defence as a Senior Regulatory Specialist Are you passionate about navigating complex regulatory landscapes and transforming regulatory requirements into practical business solutions? We are looking for a hands-on Finance Product Owner to take end-to-end responsibility for OneStream as Hempel’s strategic Enterprise Performance Management platform. You will own how the platform is designed, operated and developed across consolidation, reporting, tax, ESG, planning, budgeting and future Finance solutions. You will combine product ownership with practical system work. In addition to setting direction and governing the roadmap, you will work directly in OneStream to configure, analyse, troubleshoot, test and improve the solution. You will be the internal technical authority and escalation point, ensuring that business priorities are delivered through a coherent, stable and scalable platform. The business owns what and why. This role owns the technical how, architectural integrity and application lifecycle, working closely with Group Finance, Tax, ESG, Business Finance, Data Governance, Digital teams, developers, super users and external partners.

Key responsibilities

· Own the platform end to end. Take accountability for the OneStream roadmap, architecture, governance, operational stability, lifecycle and continuous development.

· Be hands-on in the system. Configure and maintain selected OneStream components, investigate issues, review business rules and transformations, validate integrations, execute testing and support releases and critical Finance cycles.

· Protect solution integrity. Maintain a coherent design across applications, cubes, dimensions, hierarchies, scenarios, workflows, forms, reports, business rules, integrations, security and user access.

· Manage demand and delivery. Own the change pipeline from intake and clarification through impact assessment, prioritization, design, approval, delivery, adoption and value realization.

· Translate needs into solutions. Convert Finance and reporting requirements into scalable OneStream designs, technical requirements, architecture decisions and integration specifications.

· Lead changes and releases. Coordinate enhancements, upgrades and platform maintenance, including design, regression testing, UAT, deployment readiness, communication, hypercare and stabilization.

· Ensure reliable operations. Resolve or coordinate incidents involving data loads, integrations, metadata, workflows, forms, reports, business rules, security and access, especially during closing, reporting and planning periods.

· Understand the full data flow. Assess dependencies and impacts across ERP systems, Finance data platforms, reporting solutions and other connected applications.

· Set and enforce standards. Ensure solutions are supportable, documented, secure, auditable and compliant with Finance controls and agreed platform principles.

· Build capability and adoption. Develop the OneStream super-user community and provide clear roles, escalation paths, training, release information, SOPs, FAQs and support materials.

· Connect stakeholders. Act as the primary interface between Finance, Digital, delivery teams and external partners, balancing business value, technical sustainability and available capacity.

· Drive continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate activities, improve data quality and strengthen reporting and performance management.

Qualifications and experience

· 5–8 years of experience in EPM, Finance systems, Finance transformation or a comparable product ownership role in a multinational environment.

· Strong hands-on OneStream experience. Experience with HFM, Oracle Hyperion, CCH Tagetik, BlackLine, Workday, SAP EPM or Anaplan may also be relevant.

· Practical knowledge of OneStream concepts, including cubes, dimensions, hierarchies, metadata, workflows, forms, reports, business rules, security and data integration.

· Ability to configure, analyse and troubleshoot EPM solutions, and to review and challenge business rules, transformations, integrations and technical designs. Development or coding experience is an advantage.

· Strong understanding of financial consolidation, group and management reporting, tax, planning, budgeting and forecasting processes.

· Experience owning an EPM roadmap, backlog, release cycle, change pipeline or continuous-improvement portfolio.

· Experience supporting business-critical Finance applications and managing incidents, testing, releases, upgrades and external delivery partners.

· Understanding of Finance systems architecture and integration between EPM, ERP, data platforms, BI and reporting solutions.

· Ability to translate complex Finance needs into structured requirements and scalable solutions, while managing priorities, dependencies and stakeholders.

· Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field, with full professional proficiency in English.

You are

· A proactive and independent owner who is comfortable both setting direction and doing the detailed system work.

· Structured, analytical and solution-oriented, with sound business judgement and a strong sense of accountability.

· A clear communicator who can simplify complex Finance and technical topics for different audiences.

· A collaborative relationship builder who can influence decisions across functions, cultures and seniority levels.

· Committed to sustainable solutions, disciplined governance and measurable continuous improvement.

Desirable experience

· OneStream certification or formal OneStream training.

· Experience with OneStream Planning, Tax, ESG, reporting and/or analytics

· Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, SAP S/4HANA, IFS or comparable ERP platforms.

· Experience with Finance data platforms, integration technologies, Power BI or automation tools.

· Knowledge of internal controls, access governance, auditability and regulatory reporting requirements.

Be part of the journey. Shape the future of Finance. Join us in shaping the continued evolution of OneStream as Hempel’s strategic EPM platform, connecting Finance processes, data, reporting and planning across the organization. Please submit your CV and a short motivation letter through our career portal. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Application due 2026-12-31

At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other. We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact. At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together. Hempel is a world-leading supplier of trusted coating solutions working with customers within the decorative, marine, infrastructure and energy industries. Our purpose is to shape a brighter future with sustainable coating solutions, and being owned by the Hempel Foundation gives us the stability, means and purpose to deliver lasting, positive change in the world. Do you enjoy outbound sales, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities? Are you a native or near-native German speaker with experience in B2B sales? Then you might be the next addition to our Outreach Team at PriceShape.

You'll work closely with fellow BDRs and BDMs, contributing to our sales efforts across the DACH region. While German will be your primary language when engaging with prospects, strong business-level English is essential for internal collaboration and communication with international prospects and customers.

What You'll Be Doing

• 
Identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

• 
Build relationships with relevant decision-makers and understand their business needs.

• 
Communicate PriceShape's value proposition and generate interest in our solutions.

• 
Book qualified meetings and collaborate closely with BDMs to create new sales opportunities.

• 
Share market insights and contribute to improving our outreach efforts.

What We're Looking For

• 
Native or near-native German language skills.

• 
Strong business-level English, both written and spoken.

• 
Experience in outbound B2B sales, lead generation, or business development.

• 
A proactive and goal-oriented mindset with a strong commercial drive.

• 
Confident communication and relationship-building skills.

• 
The ability to thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

Depending on your experience and proven results, the scope of the role and compensation will be tailored accordingly.

What We Offer

• 
A fast-growing SaaS company with opportunities for personal and professional development.

• 
A collaborative and international sales team with a strong team spirit.

• 
Competitive salary with uncapped commission.

• 
Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance.

• 
A modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C with great facilities, an in-house canteen, and social activities.

•

About PriceShape

PriceShape is a global leader in competitor monitoring and dynamic pricing. Our platform helps brands and online retailers track vendors' prices, stock availability, and trends while implementing tailored pricing strategies.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritize work-life balance, trust, community and focus on personal and professional growth opportunities.

We believe in trust, flexibility, and continuous development, creating an environment where people can grow both personally and professionally.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please send us your CV and application as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

For any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to People & Culture Business Partner Mathias Høgh Sønnichsen at mhs@priceshape.dk.

About the job

Pelvic organ prolapse affects millions of women, yet many are still left choosing between inadequate conservative options and invasive procedures. Sylvia Health has developed a new medical device designed to offer better support, dignity and quality of life for women living with rectocele prolapse, a major subtype of pelvic organ prolapse.

We are now looking for a Commercial Lead, potentially as a co-founder, to help bring this solution to market. This is a unique opportunity to shape the commercial future of an early-stage women's health company tackling a large, under-served and meaningful problem.

About Sylvia Health

Sylvia Health has developed a novel Class I/IIa medical device for rectocele prolapse support, designed to address an urgent unmet need in pelvic health.

Our aim is to improve quality of life for women who need better options between conservative management and invasive intervention. The product has been developed with a focus on real-world use, comfort, dignity and scalability.

We have developed and patient-tested a medical-grade product, and have recently completed our clinical study at Herlev Hospital. Although we cannot share the full results ahead of publication, we are excited by what we have seen and believe we have developed a compelling solution for the unmet need we set out to address.

We are now focused on preparing regulatory submission, expanding our team, and taking the product to market within the next 18 months. The company is supported by technical and clinical expertise, alongside a strong network of clinical and industry advisors.

Why now

Sylvia Health is entering a pivotal phase. The device has been developed and clinically tested, significant funding is in place, and we now need the right commercial co-founder to help shape the path from developed medical device to successful market entry.

This role is a founder-level opportunity to help define the commercial strategy, positioning, partnerships and market access pathway for a new category in women's health.

The role

As Commercial Lead / Co-founder, you will drive Sylvia Health's go-to-market strategy and play a central role in the company's growth.

You will work closely with the founding team, board, clinical advisors and technical partners to translate a patient-centred medical device into a credible, scalable commercial opportunity.

Key responsibilities

• 
Develop and execute a comprehensive go-to-market strategy

• 
Shape market positioning, pricing, branding and distribution strategy

• 
Build relationships with healthcare providers, hospital decision-makers, distributors and strategic partners

• 
Help define market access and reimbursement considerations across key markets

• 
Collaborate with technical and clinical functions to ensure product-market alignment

• 
Contribute to fundraising activities, investor conversations and strategic planning

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone with relevant commercial experience in medical devices/MedTech, combined with the judgement and appetite to help build an early-stage company.

Relevant experience may include:

• 
Medical device commercialisation

• 
MedTech go-to-market strategy

• 
Healthcare sales, partnerships or business development

• 
Pricing, distribution, market access or reimbursement strategy

• 
Working with hospitals, healthcare providers or medical device distributors

• 
Major medical device markets, especially Europe

• 
Early-stage company building, fundraising or investor relations

We do not expect one person to have done everything. We are looking for a commercially minded, mission-aligned operator who can help shape the opportunity.

Desired qualities

• 
Entrepreneurial mindset suited to an early-stage startup environment (essential)

• 
Strong strategic judgement and willingness to operate hands-on

• 
Ability to build trust with clinical, commercial and investor stakeholders

• 
Interest in women's health and under-served patient needs

• 
Collaborative working style and appetite for a true co-founder relationship

• 
Full-time availability preferred, though a part-time role may be possible for the right candidate

What we offer

• 
Significant equity package aligned with a true co-founder contribution

• 
Founder-level influence over company strategy, market entry and commercial direction

• 
Opportunity to help build a new category in women's health

• 
A meaningful role in improving care for women affected by pelvic organ prolapse

• 
A team with technical and clinical expertise, supported by experienced clinical and industry advisors

• 
Developed, patient-tested medical-grade product with an expected 12-24 month time to market

• 
Salary negotiable within typical MedTech startup ranges

• 
Position available immediately, with start date no later than Q1 2027

• 
Flexible location. While we are based in Copenhagen, remote work is possible for the right candidate

Application process

We would like to begin with an informal conversation. Please email your expression of interest and relevant background to Andrew (join@sylvia.health). From there, the process would likely include:

• 
An informal coffee meeting or call

• 
Candidate shortlisting based on experience and alignment

• 
Final conversation with co-founders and board

Join a fast-growing international MedTech company and take a central role in turning AI ambitions into practical, adopted solutions across the organisation.

Turn AI ambitions into practical business impact

Contura International has been named a Gazelle company two years in a row and has experienced significant growth over the past five years, increasing revenue fivefold and its number of employees tenfold.

As AI Lead, you will join Contura's IT & Projects organisation and report to the Head of IT.

In this newly established role, you will take ownership of the AI roadmap and use-case portfolio and help move AI initiatives from pilot to production.

Working across business and IT, you will drive adoption, build internal AI capability and ensure that initiatives create business value while meeting relevant quality and compliance requirements.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own and drive Contura's AI roadmap, use-case portfolio and implementation plan.

• Translate business needs into qualified use cases, requirements and solution proposals.

• Take successful AI and digital solutions from pilot into controlled production.

• Build internal AI capability through training, workshops and an AI community of champions and key users.

• Coordinate external specialists and contribute to pragmatic AI governance together with IT, Quality and Regulatory Affairs.

Business-minded AI profile with strong implementation skills

We are open regarding your professional background and previous job title. What matters most is your ability to understand business needs, turn them into relevant AI or digital solutions and create momentum from idea through implementation and adoption.

We imagine that you bring:

• Experience taking AI or digital solutions from pilot to production and driving user adoption.

• Experience translating business needs into solution proposals, requirements and priorities.

• Practical understanding of data foundations, data quality and integrations.

• Experience with AI and data solutions, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to make AI understandable and relevant across the business.

You are pragmatic, curious and delivery-oriented and comfortable creating structure and direction in an area that is still developing. You work well across functions and combine a strategic perspective with practical execution and a clear focus on business outcomes.

Turn AI into lasting business capability

This is an opportunity to take a central role in how Contura develops and applies AI as the company continues its growth and digitalisation journey.

The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Fares Almas at +45 53 69 69 84. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV.

Contura International

Contura is a fast-growing international MedTech company that develops, manufactures and commercialises innovative hydrogel-based products for treatment in areas including female urinary incontinence, orthopaedics and veterinary applications. The company has more than 20 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of therapeutic hydrogels and has experienced significant growth in recent years. Learn more about Contura at http://www.contura.dk/

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Concept & Prototype Development

**

• You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

**Simulation & Validation

**

• You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

**Driver Specification & Verification

**

• You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

• You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

• You'll support manufacturing verification with suppliers.

• You'll participate in the acoustic verification of the final product towards mass production.

• You'll collaborate with the Audio team on audio signal handling, including crossovers, compressors, and limiters.

**In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You have proven experience designing and simulating loudspeakers, including transducer design and specification, enclosure design, and acoustic measurements.

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio, Acoustics, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

• You've done loudspeaker simulation and measurements, and use both to validate and refine your designs.

• You've worked with loudspeaker development from concept through verification and ideally have experience collaborating with external manufacturing partners.

• Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

• Ideally you also have experience building physical speaker mock-ups or collaborating with large-scale loudspeaker manufacturing partners.

• You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

jobs.occupation: Design for Value & Cost Engineer – from concept to competitive edge, GN Hearing, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup.

The team you will be part of:

Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist.

In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production.

Your contribution is appreciated and you will:

• Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture

• Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options

• Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects

• Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations

• Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing

• Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing

• Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection

You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed.

You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have:

• A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics

• Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators

• Good at solving both technical and commercial issues

• General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization

• Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators

• Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken

In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions.

You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start.

We offer:

• A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business

• A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence

• Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company.

• The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN

• An international and collaborative workplace

We encourage you to apply

We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 01 April 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Research area and project description:

We are looking for a motivated and talented PhD candidate to join our multidisciplinary research team investigating climate-driven geohazards affecting infrastructure and the built environment. The successful candidate will become part of the long-term Villum Foundation research programme Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE), bringing together researchers in geotechnical, structural, coastal and environmental engineering.

The PhD project focuses on developing a multi-physics platform to simulate the coupled hydromechanical behaviour of soil interacting with water in a geotechnical context. The overall objective is to establish a combination of numerical methods under the umbrella of multi-physics modelling to assess the stability of slopes and embankments subjected to wetting–drying cycles, changes in groundwater level and saturation, surface erosion from stormwater and debris, and toe erosion from waves in coastal environments.

The integrated modelling tool should describe the onset of slope instability, accounting for different hydroclimatic triggering factors (including variations induced by climate change scenarios), and the evolution of mass movement, considering large deformation. Therefore, different numerical methods may be combined, leveraging on the advantages of each approach for simulating a specific phase of the process. It is not the intent to develop new constitutive models for specific soil types, but it may be relevant to explore the use of meso-scale models for soils such as till and fissured clays, both native to Denmark. However, while the main application should be Danish soils, the numerical framework should be developed with versatility in mind to allow the assessment of climate-driven geohazards generally in urban and coastal regions.

Project description: Applicants should submit a short research proposal (maximum 4 000 keystrokes) that demonstrates their understanding of the scientific challenge, identifies key knowledge gaps, formulates research objectives and hypotheses, outlines a possible methodological approach, and explains why their background makes them well-suited for the project. The proposal will be refined together with the supervisors during the PhD.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must hold a BSc degree (180 ECTS) in civil engineering (or a closely related engineering discipline) and an MSc degree (minimum 90 ECTS) with a specialisation in geotechnical engineering, or computational engineering or coastal engineering, including advanced coursework in numerical methods, finite element analysis, and geotechnical engineering.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

**What you will do

**

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

**

What you bring**

_Experience and skills (Required)

_

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

_Nice to have

_

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

**What we offer

**

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.
